title: The Serpent's Trick
lesson: The oldest trick is making you doubt what God said.
lines: The serpent was the most cunning creature in the garden. And he had a question.
Did God really say you can't eat from any tree? he hissed to Eve.
Only that one, said Eve. Oh, you won't die, said the serpent. You'll be like God!
She looked. She wanted. She took a bite. And gave some to Adam too.
Suddenly their eyes were opened. They felt ashamed, and stitched clothes out of fig leaves.
When God came walking in the garden, they hid behind a bush. From God. Who made the bush.
Adam blamed Eve. Eve blamed the serpent. The serpent had no legs to stand on. The oldest trick in the book? Making you doubt what God said.
Next time: two brothers, two offerings, and a jealous heart. Follow so you don't miss it!
